aegishiderConfig.text:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Aegishider 3.1.0 - server-side anti-ESP visibility control
#
# Security model: FAIL-CLOSED.
#   * A protected block/entity is hidden from a viewer unless the visibility
#     policy explicitly proves it is allowed to be sent.
#   * Unknown state, disabled module, missing packet gateway, timeout, error
#     and queue pressure all keep data hidden - never the opposite.
#
# Packet gateway requirement:
#   Block/container/chunk protection is only possible by rewriting outgoing
#   packets. That requires the PacketEvents plugin to be installed. If it is
#   absent, Aegishider disables block protection entirely (and says so in logs
#   and /aegishider status) instead of sending data first and patching later.
#   Entity/item protection uses Paper's native per-player entity visibility
#   API and works without PacketEvents (packet-level checks are added when the
#   gateway is active).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

security:
  # Keep true in production. There is no "fast but unsafe" mode.
  fail-closed: true
  packet-gateway:
    # Minimum PacketEvents version that is known to expose the APIs Aegishider
    # uses (chunk column / block state rewriting, packet cancellation).
    minimum-version: "2.14.0"
  # Global per-tick time budget for Aegishider's main-thread security work.
  # Work is sliced and deferred when the budget is exceeded; visibility
  # decisions are never skipped, only delayed by at most a few ticks.
  main-thread-budget-ms: 1.5
  # Shared raycast budget per tick for block occlusion + entity occlusion.
  # Raise for large storage bases if visible-blocks reveal feels slow; lower to
  # reduce CPU. 0 = no raycasts (everything stays hidden - fail-closed).
  raycast-budget-per-tick: 300

worlds:
  # Settings under "default" apply to every world that is not explicitly
  # listed below. Add e.g. "world_nether:" with the same structure to override.
  default:
    enabled: true
    bypass-permission: aegishider.bypass

    block-protection:
      enabled: true
      # These blocks are hidden at packet level. They are discovered from real
      # block-entity data (natural structures included) and tracked on place/
      # break/explosion/piston events plus a background reconciliation sweep.
      # Only tile-entity backed materials are supported; unsupported entries
      # are rejected with a console warning instead of being silently ignored.
      hidden-blocks:
        - CHEST
        - TRAPPED_CHEST
        - ENDER_CHEST
        - BARREL
        - SHULKER_BOX
        - WHITE_SHULKER_BOX
        - ORANGE_SHULKER_BOX
        - MAGENTA_SHULKER_BOX
        - LIGHT_BLUE_SHULKER_BOX
        - YELLOW_SHULKER_BOX
        - LIME_SHULKER_BOX
        - PINK_SHULKER_BOX
        - GRAY_SHULKER_BOX
        - LIGHT_GRAY_SHULKER_BOX
        - CYAN_SHULKER_BOX
        - PURPLE_SHULKER_BOX
        - BLUE_SHULKER_BOX
        - BROWN_SHULKER_BOX
        - GREEN_SHULKER_BOX
        - RED_SHULKER_BOX
        - BLACK_SHULKER_BOX
        - HOPPER
        - DROPPER
        - DISPENSER
        - FURNACE
        - BLAST_FURNACE
        - SMOKER
        - BREWING_STAND
        - SPAWNER
        - TRIAL_SPAWNER
        - VAULT
      replace-with: STONE

      # Blocks become visible to a viewer only when they are close, inside the
      # field of view and not occluded. Once seen, they stay visible while the
      # viewer remains close (prevents flicker); they are hidden again when the
      # viewer leaves, the chunk is resent, or the world changes.
      reveal:
        max-distance: 12.0
        fov-degrees: 120.0
        keep-distance-factor: 1.6
        # Re-raycast revealed blocks when the viewer moved this far (blocks).
        recheck-move-blocks: 4
      # Background reconciliation sweep: catches blocks changed by plugins,
      # commands or mechanics that do not fire a Bukkit block event.
      reconcile:
        enabled: true
        chunks-per-second: 40
        # Only chunks within this many chunks of a player are reconciled.
        player-radius-chunks: 8

    item-protection:
      enabled: true
      # Entity types that are hidden by default and only revealed through the
      # same distance/FOV/occlusion policy. ITEM covers every dropped item
      # (player, mob, block, natural, custom, enchanted, shulker contents...).
      # Additional safe candidates: ITEM_FRAME, GLOW_ITEM_FRAME, ARMOR_STAND,
      # CHEST_MINECART, HOPPER_MINECART. Player entities are intentionally not
      # supported (would break team/combat gameplay; see README).
      hidden-entity-types:
        - ITEM
      reveal:
        max-distance: 32.0
        fov-degrees: 130.0
        # The player who threw/dropped an item sees it immediately.
        owner-grace: true
      # Re-evaluate item visibility every N ticks.
      update-interval-ticks: 2

# Optional, non-enforcing analytics. They never alter visibility decisions and
# never ban/kick automatically. Alerts go to players with aegishider.admin.
analytics:
  mining:
    enabled: false
    xray-ore-rate-threshold-percent: 5.0
    min-samples: 200
    tunnel-streak-blocks: 24
    alert-cooldown-seconds: 120
  raid:
    enabled: false
    alert-cooldown-seconds: 300

debug:
  # Log one line per blocked packet category (rate limited). Keep false in prod.
  log-blocked-packets: false
  # Log a warning when the per-tick budget is exceeded (rate limited).
  log-budget-overruns: true
  # Dump stack traces for internal security errors. Always logged at SEVERE.
  verbose-errors: false
